name: My Launch Stash

sources.title: My Launch Stash homepage — product launch directory for SaaS/app launches
Submit page — 'Log in to Submit' wall with Google sign-in

requirements: Products in scope: SaaS launches, app launches, early-stage software releases
Account mandatory: /submit shows 'Log in to Submit' — Google sign-in or account creation
preparation: Category from their shared taxonomy (AI Assistants, Dev Tools, Marketing, etc.) and a pricing label
A Google account or email for signup
workflow: Create an account at /signup or log in with Google (/api/auth/google?redirect=/submit)
watchFor: Same template family as goodaitools.com and launchclash.com (identical category footer and submitsaas.com ad banner) — treat the third-party '140+ directories' ad as a separate paid service
No public pricing, review, or backlink terms found on reachable pages
countsAsLive: A product detail page on mylaunchstash.com linked from Latest or the Explore/category listing
unknowns: Free vs paid submission terms — not visible publicly
Form fields and whether a badge/backlink is required
